en.headline: Strong Monsoon Signal remains in force under hot and windy conditions
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory reported temperatures around 31–33°C at noon with very high UV levels; strong easterly winds continue and the public is advised to beware of rough seas.
body: The Strong Monsoon Signal remained in force at midday on Wednesday as strong easterly winds continued to affect Hong Kong.

At noon the Hong Kong Observatory recorded 31 degrees Celsius and relative humidity of 66 per cent. The mean UV Index at King’s Park reached 10, indicating very high intensity. Temperatures at other stations ranged from about 30 to 33 degrees.

The Observatory warned that hot weather might cause adverse health effects and advised the public to stay alert and drink more water. Strong winds from the east are expected to persist, and people should beware of the possible danger brought by rough seas, especially offshore.
From midnight to noon only 1.9 millimetres of rain fell at the Observatory. The signal was first issued on Tuesday evening and has remained in force through Wednesday morning and into the afternoon.

zh.headline: 強烈季候風信號繼續生效 天氣炎熱吹偏東強風
zh.dek: 天文台中午錄得約31至33度，紫外線指數極高；偏東強風持續，市民須提防海面大浪。
body: 強烈季候風信號周三中午仍然生效，本港繼續吹偏東強風。
天文台中午錄得氣溫31度，相對濕度66%。京士柏平均紫外線指數達10，強度屬極高。其他地區氣溫介乎約30至33度。
天文台提醒，炎熱天氣可能影響健康，市民應保持警惕並多補充水分。預料偏東強風持續，市民須提防海面大浪可能帶來的危險，尤其離岸水域。
由午夜至中午，天文台只錄得1.9毫米雨量。該信號於周二晚間發出，周三上午及下午繼續生效。
